name: Taming the Beast
summary: This quest is the second trial in the dwarf hunter initiation given by Grif Wildheart in Kharanos. After learning to handle the brute resilience of a crag boar, the young hunter is tasked with mastering the swiftness and lethal grace of a native snow leopard.

sections.title: A Lesson in Finesse
sections.body: While crag boars teach a mountaineer how to withstand raw ferocity and absorb blows, Grif Wildheart emphasizes that a master hunter must understand different styles of combat. He points his students southeast toward the prowling snow leopards of Dun Morogh. Grif compares these graceful predators to an elegantly crafted rifle: outwardly striking, yet concealing devastating power beneath their pristine white coats.

sections.title: Mastering the Taming Rod
sections.body: Using an enchanted taming rod, the hunter must confront a wild leopard and bend its hunting instincts into partnership. Snow leopards test agility, speed, and sharp reflexes rather than pure endurance. Mastering such a creature demonstrates that the novice can harmonize with predators that strike swiftly from the snowy crags, taking another step toward true command over the beasts of the wild.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: It is the second stage of the hunter rite of passage for dwarves. Hunter trainer Grif Wildheart requires his students to test their skills against diverse wilderness beasts before granting them the knowledge to permanently bond with animal companions.

faq.q: Where do I find the snow leopards?
aliases: where are snow leopards dun morogh
faq.answer: Snow leopards can be found prowling the rocky crags and snowy slopes south and east of Kharanos in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why does Grif Wildheart want me to tame a leopard?
faq.answer: Grif believes a hunter must experience both burly strength and refined finesse. Where the crag boar relies on brute resilience, the snow leopard teaches the hunter how to fight alongside a swift, agile, and lethal damage dealer.

faq.q: Do I get to keep this snow leopard permanently?
aliases: can i keep the snow leopard
faq.answer: No. The beasts tamed during these initial trials are temporary training partners bound by the magic of the taming rod. Once Grif deems your training complete at the end of the quest chain, you gain the permanent ability to tame any wild beast you choose.
Grif Wildheart, the dwarf hunter trainer stationed outside the inn in Kharanos, Dun Morogh.

faq.q: What comes next in the chain?
faq.answer: After demonstrating mastery over the snow leopard, Grif sends you on a third and final taming trial to master an Ice Claw Bear before officially teaching you how to tame and train wild beasts on your own.

angles.text: This rite of passage teaches novice dwarven hunters the contrast between high-durability pets like boars and swift, aggressive damage dealers like cats.
Mountaineers of Khaz Modan have long shared the frozen peaks of Dun Morogh with snow leopards, respecting both their stealth and lethal hunting prowess.
